title: Rhein attenuates oxidative stress-induced injury in human ovarian granulosa cells by inhibiting the NF-kappaB-TNF-alpha/IL-6/PTGS2 inflammatory axis.
authors: Li, Yang; Qiu, Jishuang; Zhou, Yanru; Jiang, Yuanyuan; Li, Xin; Weng, Ying; Chen, Yang; Lai, Yong; Yang, Wanqi
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨大黄酸对PCOS样颗粒细胞氧化/炎症损伤的保护作用，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Polycystic ovary syndrome with insulin resistance (PCOS-IR) features oxidative stress, chronic inflammation, and lipid dysregulation that impair granulosa cells. This study evaluated whether Rhein mitigates oxidative/inflammatory injury in granulosa cells under PCOS-like conditions and explored its putative molecular basis. A PCOS-like metabolic injury model was established in human granulosa-like KGN cells using dihydrotestosterone, oleic acid, and palmitic acid. Reactive oxygen species (ROS), malondialdehyde (MDA), mitochondrial membrane potential (DeltaPsim), and lipid accumulation were measured by DCFH-DA fluorescence, MDA assay, JC-1 staining, and Oil Red O, respectively. Western blotting assessed NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, IL-6, and PTGS2. Network pharmacology, molecular docking, 100-ns molecular dynamics simulations were used to prioritize targets and evaluate binding stability. KEGG enrichment was used to infer related pathways. Rhein (10-20 muM) reduced ROS and MDA, partially restored DeltaPsim, and lessened lipid accumulation versus model controls. Docking and MD results indicated stable binding of Rhein to NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, IL-6, and PTGS2. Enrichment analysis suggested that the NF-kappaB-TNF-alpha/IL-6/PTGS2 inflammatory axis may constitute the core regulatory axis. Western blotting further confirmed downregulation of PTGS2, IL-6, TNF-alpha, and NF-kappaB protein expression. Rhein attenuates oxidative and inflammatory stress in KGN cells under PCOS-like metabolic injury, likely via modulation of the NF-kappaB-TNF-alpha/IL-6/PTGS2 inflammatory axis. These in vitro findings support Rhein as a pharmacological candidate for further investigation in reproductive endocrine disorders associated with insulin resistance.
abstract_zh: 伴有胰岛素抵抗的多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS-IR）以氧化应激、慢性炎症和脂质代谢紊乱为特征，这些因素损害颗粒细胞。本研究评估了大黄酸（Rhein）是否在PCOS样条件下减轻颗粒细胞的氧化/炎症损伤，并探讨其可能的分子基础。使用双氢睾酮、油酸和棕榈酸在人颗粒样KGN细胞中建立了PCOS样代谢损伤模型。分别通过DCFH-DA荧光、MDA测定、JC-1染色和油红O检测活性氧（ROS）、丙二醛（MDA）、线粒体膜电位（DeltaPsim）和脂质积累。Western blotting评估了NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha、IL-6和PTGS2的表达。采用网络药理学、分子对接和100纳秒分子动力学模拟来优先排序靶点并评估结合稳定性。使用KEGG富集分析推断相关通路。与模型对照组相比，大黄酸（10-20μM）降低了ROS和MDA，部分恢复了DeltaPsim，并减少了脂质积累。对接和MD结果表明大黄酸与NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha、IL-6和PTGS2稳定结合。富集分析提示NF-kappaB-TNF-alpha/IL-6/PTGS2炎症轴可能构成核心调控轴。Western blotting进一步证实了PTGS2、IL-6、TNF-alpha和NF-kappaB蛋白表达的下调。大黄酸在PCOS样代谢损伤下减轻KGN细胞的氧化和炎症应激，可能通过调节NF-kappaB-TNF-alpha/IL-6/PTGS2炎症轴实现。这些体外发现支持大黄酸作为与胰岛素抵抗相关的生殖内分泌疾病进一步研究的药理学候选药物。
